_comment: Few-shot examples for prompts.build_alert_narration_prompt: 2 per scenario. Invented sites and numbers; facts are rendered with prompts.format_facts exactly like live alerts.

drivers.signal: heat-related clinic encounters in the catchment

readings.signal: heat-related clinic encounters in the catchment

approved_actions: Move heavy outdoor tasks before 10:00 or after 16:00.
Put a first-aider with cooling kit on standby on site.

heat-stress-cluster.response: A heat-stress cluster advisory is active for Example Logistics Park in Dubai this afternoon. Apparent temperature drives 61% of the signal at 47.3 °C against a usual 41.0 °C, which raises the risk of heat illness for outdoor crews, and worker absence is also above normal at 7.9%. The safety officer should move heavy outdoor tasks to before 10:00 or after 16:00 and put a first-aider with a cooling kit on standby.

drivers.signal: heat-related clinic encounters in the catchment

approved_actions: Enforce water and shade breaks every 30 minutes at all outdoor work faces.
Brief crews on heat-illness symptoms and buddy checks.

heat-stress-cluster.response: A heat-stress cluster watch has been issued for Example Free Zone Phase 2 and Example Harbour Yard in Abu Dhabi this morning. Worker absence accounts for 48% of the signal at 9.1% against a usual 4.5%, an early sign that crews may already be feeling the 41.6 °C apparent temperature. The site supervisor should enforce water and shade breaks every 30 minutes at all outdoor work faces.

drivers.signal: respiratory clinic encounters in the catchment

approved_actions: Move outdoor PE and break-time activities indoors for sensitive groups.
Issue FFP2 masks to outdoor site crews.

respiratory-dust-event.response: A respiratory / dust event watch is in effect for Example Rail Corridor in Abu Dhabi this morning. PM2.5 drives 58% of the signal at 71.4 µg/m³, roughly three times its usual 24.0 µg/m³, and fine particles at this level can aggravate breathing problems for outdoor workers. The safety officer should issue FFP2 masks to all outdoor site crews before the next work period.

drivers.signal: respiratory clinic encounters in the catchment

readings.signal: respiratory clinic encounters in the catchment

approved_actions: Suspend outdoor school activities; keep windows closed and HVAC on recirculate.
Prioritise asthma/COPD patients for follow-up in affected catchments.

respiratory-dust-event.response: A respiratory / dust event advisory is active for Example Towers Site in Sharjah this afternoon. Respiratory clinic encounters in the catchment account for 44% of the signal at 14 per 24 h against a usual 6.2, which suggests the 63.0 µg/m³ PM2.5 is already affecting people nearby. The operations manager should keep site offices and welfare cabins closed with HVAC on recirculate and move outdoor activity indoors where possible.

febrile clinic encounters in the catchment

readings.signal: all-cause clinic encounters in the catchment
febrile clinic encounters in the catchment

approved_actions: Review syndromic line lists for the catchment; check for common exposure sites.

infectious-cluster-signal.response: An infectious cluster signal watch has been raised for the catchment around Example Labour Village in Dubai this morning. All-cause clinic encounters drive 66% of the signal at 212 per 24 h against a usual 171.4, with febrile encounters also roughly double their normal level, which can be an early hint of a communicable illness cluster. The medical lead should review the aggregate syndromic line lists for the catchment and check for a common exposure site.

all-cause clinic encounters in the catchment

readings.signal: febrile clinic encounters in the catchment

approved_actions: Request site clinics to report febrile workers daily; reinforce hand hygiene and shared-accommodation ventilation.

infectious-cluster-signal.response: An infectious cluster signal advisory is active for Example Industrial City Block C in Ajman this evening. Febrile clinic encounters account for 52% of the signal at 24 per 24 h against a usual 10.1, and worker absence has risen to 6.8%, so illness may be spreading in shared settings. The HR lead should ask site clinics to report daily counts of febrile workers and reinforce hand hygiene and ventilation in shared accommodation.
